title: Meghan Markle's father arrested on charges related to child sexual abuse material: AP
summary: Thomas Markle, the father of Prince Harry's wife, Meghan, was arrested Friday morning by federal agents in Florida on charges related to child sexual abuse material, people familiar with the matter…

image.caption: A file photo of a CBC News breaking news logo. (CBC)

blocks.text: Thomas Markle, the father of Prince Harry's wife, Meghan, was arrested Friday morning by federal agents in Florida on charges related to child sexual abuse material, people familiar with the matter told The Associated Press.
Sources say he was arrested Friday morning by federal agents in Florida
The people who confirmed his arrest were not authorized to publicly discuss the investigation and spoke on the condition of anonymity.
Thomas Markle was taken into custody near Tampa.
